capabilities: Transcribe local audio and video files from the vault
Transcribe Bilibili, Douyin and Xiaohongshu links, including pasted share text
Split transcripts into time-based chapters with per-sentence timestamps
Write new notes with YAML frontmatter, summary and embedded source media
Submit multi-part Bilibili videos as one note per selected part
disambiguation: Not an AI chat assistant; it only turns audio, video and supported platform links into transcript notes.
extras: Uploads the selected file or pasted link to api.diting.cc for transcription; free tier is 30 minutes per month. Desktop only (isDesktopOnly: true). Timestamp jumps work only in Reading view and only when the source media is embedded in the note. Link transcription writes to 00-Inbox without a per-file path prompt and never overwrites existing notes.
problem: Audio and video content in a vault stays unsearchable text-wise, and there is no built-in way to turn spoken material into linked, timestamped notes.
summary: Transcribes local audio/video files or Bilibili, Douyin and Xiaohongshu links into timestamped, chaptered Markdown notes.
